findings.where: ab4 privacy tether (#teth4, page x 871, y 3992-4056)
findings.problem: The red tether (#CC3328) runs through the kern's drop shadow; sampled contrast against the adjacent background is 1.14-2.94:1 along most of its length and 1.89:1 where it fades near the node (4.15:1 only at the node). Not a WCAG failure: the asking node is also marked by its red ring and the text 'Webvenster vraagt internet'.
findings.fix: Clear the kern shadow in a 12 px strip under the tether, or give the tether a 1 px light keyline, so it reaches 3:1 over its whole length.

findings.where: ab2 launcher group heads (Bestanden, Acties, Assistent)
findings.problem: Group heads use type.title 22/28 600 as TYPOGRAPHY 8.2 prescribes for group heads, so they visually outweigh the 15 px result names (subjective; carried from the earlier critic).
findings.fix: Leave to the typography owner; caption 13/18 or body-strong would keep results dominant.

findings.where: ab3 status line '5 items' and ab5 place-map caption '1 keer toegestaan vandaag'
findings.problem: Tabular figures (.num) are applied to counts inside prose, beyond clocks, sizes and table dates.
Real keyboard focus shows Chrome's default focus ring (rendered, visible on dark and light), not the designed 2 px --focus ring; the designed ring appears only as static .fx specimens (16-19.8:1).
findings.fix: Optionally add :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px} so live focus matches the specimen.

findings.where: planner acceptance for MF5, MF7, MF8 versus its css_tokens_to_change
findings.problem: The plan requires chroma <=12 for blades and sidebar icons, but its own tokens render at chroma 15 (#E6EBF5), 26 (#2B3245) and 34 (#A9B2CB). The board follows the tokens; this recheck judged neutrality against G8 (<=40). Carried from the earlier critic.
findings.fix: Owner decision in ds-1.0: relax the threshold to <=40 or adopt true neutral greys.

findings.problem: Text diff against v1: the Motion table no longer specifies the loader (1400 ms loop, text status after 10 s) or the rule that nothing loops for decoration, and the focused/unfocused title-area explanation is gone. The loader itself is still drawn.
findings.fix: Add a Loader row to the Motion table and a one-line focused/unfocused caption under the title-area specimen.

Failures found only for text occluded by other windows; disabled specimens and scrimmed or inert app content are exempt.

Under reduced motion, frames at 3.3, 4.5 and 6 s are identical; the static frame shows mark, wordmark and a static halo ring.

Thumbnails of ab5 and ab6 were also viewed.

Plan acceptance read in full for MF2, MF5-MF8, G1 and G2: no numeric contrast criterion for the tether; G1 geometry (+-2 px, touching ends) met; MF2 'within 4' met in intent (well is less chromatic than Orbit, same hue).
summary: All six 1440x900 artboards were rendered at 100 % and 200 %, under reduced motion and with live keyboard focus, and viewed. Text and component contrast was sampled on rendered pixels. Every earlier blocker and major finding is resolved in the render: continuity text 9-17:1 over wallpaper and plate, ab4 tether and ab3 inspector tether attached, columns fit, version days restored, place-map icons and content restored, C1 crop shows window and duration row, ab6 token and component coverage restored. Six minor findings remain: tether contrast through the kern shadow, launcher group-head weight per TYPOGRAPHY, .num on two prose counts, browser-default live focus ring, the plan's chroma threshold contradicting its own tokens, and a thinner ab6 motion spec than v1. Originals are unchanged.
limitations: Layouts at 1280x720 and a true 200 % zoom reflow (720 CSS px viewport) were not rendered.
High contrast exists only as a 25 % specimen; a full high-contrast theme was not available to render.
Animation timing was checked by comparing frames at virtual times, not watched in real time.
This recheck is an AI review, not an independent human audit.
